_help: 19 real queries across 4 quadrants with a ~60/40 train/validation split. Near-misses steer away from the sibling engineering-axis skill (/lead-decompose creates type:subsystem issues) and the intake skill (/prd-validate).

queries.query: sync the PRD user stories to GitHub issues
create the type:story backlog from docs/PRD.md
reconcile the GitHub backlog after the PRD changed
populate the backlog from the frozen requirements
the PRD is done, can you turn its stories into GitHub tickets?
we updated a couple of user stories in the PRD, update the issues without making duplicates
get the product backlog into GitHub as draft issues for the PO to review
make sure every user story in the PRD has a matching GitHub issue
push the stories from requirements into the tracker as a starting backlog
create the subsystem tracking issues from the traceability matrix
queries.note: engineering axis (type:subsystem) — that is the /lead-decompose subsystem step, not the PO backlog

queries.query: validate this draft PRD and freeze it
queries.note: PRD intake/authoring is /prd-validate; backlog sync consumes an already-frozen PRD

queries.query: write a python script to reconcile GitHub issues via the gh CLI
queries.note: tooling implementation task, not running the PO backlog sync

queries.query: open a pull request and merge the completed subsystem branch
break the architecture into subsystems and author their SPEC.md contracts
decompose the system and assign subsystem ownership to tech leads
write the failing test suites from the acceptance criteria
run the STRIDE security audit on the proposed architecture
implement the redirect_resolver module against its frozen spec
